snippet.title: Kamla | Coming to Nintendo Switch and PlayStation 5!
snippet.description:
Set in 1980s India, you follow the story of Kamla, a woman currently tormented by a demon. A year after her marriage into a wealthy family, she begins losing her sanity. You play as a priest, sent in to help Kamla and perform an exorcism ritual. 

Kamla will be available on the Nintendo Switch on 30th October 2025, with PlayStation 5 versions coming later.
